name: CortexBench
description: CortexBench is a comprehensive benchmark suite consisting of 17 tasks spanning locomotion, navigation, dexterous, and mobile manipulation to evaluate pre-trained visual representations for Embodied AI.
reputation: CortexBench is a well-known embodied AI benchmark suite used to compare pre-trained visual representations across multiple robotics tasks.
notes: Largest empirical study of pre-trained visual representations for Embodied AI; includes real-world hardware experiments; no new techniques but extensive evaluation.
